summary: Created a 5-phase, fully sequential implementation plan (est. 4.75h) for rendering docs/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.md as a single self-contained Typst document at typst/ModalAxiomArchitecture/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.typ (build output to build/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.pdf). Phase 1 stands up the scaffold/preamble/notation/front-matter and resolves the flagged open item by grepping live Lean source for the exact Axioms.AxiomB expansion before it is printed. Phases 2-4 author the seven source sections in outline order (Schema-Tag Alphabet + syntactic cube; unionSound hinge + HasAxiom* insulation; S5/Design Rationale/Scope Boundary + source-anchor appendix), collapsing the source's redundant passages into tables and one fletcher cube diagram while keeping load-bearing Lean signatures as literal fenced code blocks. Each authoring phase ends with an incremental typst compile. Phase 5 verifies a clean compile (exit 0), cross-checks fidelity and concision against the source, and greps the deliverable for ephemeral task-number references per the no-task-references rule. Plan reuses typst/MPL house style and notation macros throughout.
decisions_made: Fully sequential 5-phase plan (single-file .typ deliverable means each authoring phase builds on the previous; no parallel waves).

Phase 1 folds the Axioms.AxiomB live-Lean grep verification in early, before Section 3's correspondence table is authored in Phase 3, so the B-row schema is confirmed (or explicitly cited opaquely) before it is printed.
Each authoring phase ends with an incremental typst compile so compilation errors surface early rather than only in the final verification phase.

Fletcher cube diagram kept as a stretch enhancement with a grouped-table fallback (planned degradation, not failure); axiom schemas transcribed from literal Lean Satisfies.*_axiom conclusions, not textbook memory.
Phase 5 explicitly greps the .typ deliverable for task-number citation patterns to honor the no-task-references-in-deliverables rule, since the file lives outside specs/**.
